messages:
tariq: hey folks, quick ping — I opened a PR that adds a migration + backfill for the new `user_profiles` table (used by ingest pipeline). can someone take a look when you have a sec? https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/742

katie: thanks for the ping. putting it on my queue now. quick Q: is the backfill going to be single txn or piecewise?

tariq: backfill is currently a batch job that scans the events table and writes profiles. not a single TXN. plan is to run it in parallel workers with idempotency keys.

jonathan: can you paste the backfill snippet? want to confirm it uses (created_at) windowing to avoid full table locks.

katie: also, does the migration add any indexes that will cause long rebuilds?

maria: infra-bot: ci status?\n
infra-bot: ci/pipeline — all checks passed for PR #742 (build, unit, integration).

tariq: snippet: ```python
# backfill worker pseudo
for start in window_ranges:
    rows = select events where created_at >= start and created_at < end limit 10000
    for r in rows:
        upsert into user_profiles (user_id, last_seen) values (...)
```
no blocking index rebuilds; we add a nullable column and a lightweight index on (user_id) which is created without CONCURRENTLY in the migration right now.

sre-jen: please don't create index without CONCURRENTLY on prod. that can lock writes. we should either:
- create index CONCURRENTLY in a separate migration, or
- create it in staging first and schedule maintenance window for prod if needed.

tariq: ack. I'll split the index into a separate PR and mark it CONCURRENTLY.

katie: also recommend adding a small safety TTL config for the backfill to keep memory bounded and a checkpoint table to resume if job dies.

jonathan: agree. add a checkpoint row with last_processed_id and batch_size env var. makes resuming safe.

maria: fwiw, I ran the backfill locally on a sample dataset and it looked fine. no duplicates due to upsert. included logs in the PR.

tariq: thanks — updated PR with checkpoint table and split index PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/743 (index-only)

katie: left a couple of inline comments about transactions and retry backoff.

jonathan: added an approval on the migration PR after verifying it runs in staging and there's a rollback plan.

sre-jen: can we schedule the production backfill for Tuesday 02:00 UTC? that minimizes traffic. tag me when you plan the run.

tariq: scheduling for Tue 02:00 UTC works. I'll open a runbook in the ops channel and @sre-jen before starting.

maria: small nit: please include metrics emit (gauge) for backfill progress so we can watch in Grafana.

tariq: good call — added a prometheus counter in the PR.

katie: LGTM pending infra-bot green and index PR merged with CONCURRENTLY.

infra-bot: status: PR 742 checks passed; PR 743 pending review.

tariq: thanks all. will wait for 743 to merge, then queue the migration runbook and do the backfill on Tue slot. ping me if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

jonathan: approved 743, merged index CONCURRENTLY.

infra-bot: deployment to staging succeeded.

maria: awesome — thanks team.

katie: merging migration after deploy sanity checks pass. good job.

sre-jen: closing loop — I'll be on standby during Tue run.

tariq: closing thread, will post runbook link in ops before the run.
